patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (Mom) We were crossing the street and I swung her up by the hand — now she won't use that arm at all and cries if I touch it. She just holds it kind of limp.
clinical.presentationShort: 2yo F — axial traction to the arm; holds R arm flexed & pronated, refuses use, no swelling/deformity/point tenderness, NV intact.
clinical.presentationLong: 2-year-old female, arm pulled while crossing the street, now holds the right arm slightly flexed and pronated and refuses to use it, with no swelling, deformity, or point tenderness.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → reduction (supination-flexion or hyperpronation), observe return of use; discharge.
diagnosis.why: Mechanism (axial pull) + limp pronated arm nails nursemaid's elbow — no X-ray; reduce and she uses it in minutes.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: on the clinic chair, holding one arm limp against her body
signs: right arm held limp and close to the body
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 2-year-old toddler girl with curly hair, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: holding her right arm limp against her body, refusing to move it. Expression: unhappy and teary. Clearly visible: the right arm held limp and close to the body. No text, no logos.
